snippet.title: Journey to the Void - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Journey to the Void is OUT NOW on Steam!

Find a body to possess, build your deck, and face the Void.
Surrounded by enemies, with no way to escape. Will you endure the Void?

A tactical roguelite where you’re stuck at the center of the grid: survival depends on carefully chaining cards with unique attack patterns, turning each encounter into a strategic puzzle.

Begin your journey NOW and take advantage of the -10% launch discount, available for a limited time!

* Master elemental synergies, powerful combos, and exploitable vulnerabilities
* 300+ cards, weapons, and items and 8 elemental biomes that actively affect combat.
* Permanent moral choices that shape both your run and the world
* Grid-based combat closer to turn-based strategy than a classic card game

Every run is different.
Every choice matters.
Choose what to sacrifice.

Journey to the Void is OUT NOW: play the full game or go try the demo!
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3210490/Journey_to_the_Void/
